newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil car output up 17.2 pct in Sept - report.
newsitem.headline: Brazil car output up 17.2 pct in Sept - report.

text.p: Brazilian car output reached 137,371 vehicles in September, up 17.2 percent from the same month last year, Brazil's Motor Manufacturers Association (Anfavea) said in a report.
However, September output was down 2.30 percent from the 140,610 vehicles assembled in August, it said.
Car output in the first nine months of the year rose 10.8 from a year earlier, to 1.13 million vehicles, it said.
Domestic car sales in September rose 24.9 percent from a year earlier, to 166,270 from 133,124. Sales fell 7.17 percent compared with August sales of 179,103 cars.
Brazilian car manufacturers exported 30,549 vehicles last month, against 22,131 in September 1995, up 38.04 percent, it said.
September exports were flat compared with the 30,530 cars exported in August, it added.
